name: airo-doffy-structured-beaver-serial-c12-bs32
description: Sequential batch-size-32 training of dp_beaver_enc, dp_beaver_near, and dp_beaver_near_gate with 8 data workers, W&B, and HF uploads

command: set -Eeuo pipefail; stage_dir=/tmp/airo_structured_beaver_stage; ready_file=${stage_dir}/READY; echo 'Waiting for authenticated source/data staging...'; for stage_attempt in $(seq 1 900); do if [ -f "${ready_file}" ]; then exec bash "${stage_dir}/run-structured-beaver-sequential-cluster12-bs32.sh"; fi; sleep 2; done; echo 'Timed out waiting for staged inputs' >&2; exit 2
